name: hermes-commander
description: Local computer control for ChatGPT Desktop through Hermes Node.

interface.longDescription: Hermes Commander gives ChatGPT Desktop local MCP tools backed by Hermes Node for files, terminal, processes, screenshots, Windows UI Automation, semantic element control, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and a managed Chrome surface. It is intended for computers you own and control.
capabilities: Inspect and operate semantic UI elements
